system_overview: city-noise-map is a crowdsourced city noise measurements with heatmap tiles. It is built as a small focused system with Mobile Capture at its core, supported by Tile Renderer (end-to-end) and Calibration Service.

recommended_language.rationale: Python fits the crowdsourced city noise measurements with heatmap tiles workload on technical grounds.

quality_goals.goal: Correct output under normal failure modes

architecture_decisions.title: Use Mobile Capture as the system core
architecture_decisions.rationale: The crowdsourced city noise measurements with heatmap tiles hinges on this component working well.

positive: Single place to harden the critical path
negative: Core component becomes a bottleneck for change

ruled_out.rejection_reason: Operational overhead for a small system.

architecture_decisions.title: Run Calibration Service asynchronously
architecture_decisions.rationale: Keeps the interactive path fast on modest hardware.

ruled_out.rejection_reason: Ties user latency to slow external work.

what_not_to_build: A plugin system before there are users

risk_flags.risk: External dependency outage stalls the async path
risk_flags.mitigation: Retry with backoff and a dead-letter table.

open_questions: What is the realistic peak concurrent usage?
constraints: Entities Measurement, Device, Tile must persist relationally
Components: Mobile Capture, Tile Renderer (end-to-end), Calibration Service
